arguments.command:
cd /tmp/writable_ws && python3 -c "
import re

tests = [
    '(.+?) *',                    # anonymous left-aligned
    '(?P<a>.+?) *',               # named left-aligned  
    ' *(.+?) *',                  # center-aligned (with leading spaces)
]

for expr in tests:
    print(f'Input: {repr(expr)}')
    
    # Anonymous group (.+?) followed by space*
    result1 = re.sub(r'\(\.\+\?\)\ \*', r'([^ ]+)', expr)
    print(f'  After anon sub: {repr(result1)}')
    
    # Named group (?P<name>.+?) followed by space*  
    result2 = re.sub(r'\(\?P<\w+>\.\+\?\)\ \*', r'(?P<\g<0>[^ ]+)', result1)
    print(f'  After named sub attempt: {repr(result2)}')

print()
# Better approach for named groups
expr = '(?P<a>.+?) *'
result = re.sub(r'\(\?P<(\w+)>\.\+\?\)\ \*', r'(?P<\1>[^ ]+)', expr)
print(f'Named with backref: {repr(result)}')
"
